items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: And he taught me to read... And so well that I could read mostly anything written.

ctx.x: And he... And he... I bought a set of bells, and I used to play the violin parts on the orchestra bells, and later on I bought xylophones. And he taught me to read... And so well that I could read mostly anything written.

And I know Baby Dobbs once told me that you were the only really Finnish drummer in Chicago, he thought. That is, that you were a wonderful musician, could read, and you could play all of the different instruments. Xylophone, of course, seems Baby never learned some of those other instruments like the bells. And so he always told me about you were really what he called a Finnish drummer. And you didn't have any special instruction on the bells, except just learning to read that time, or did...
